up: Retrieve the ChEMBL ID, preferred name, max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all molecules reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1944551. Join docs (filtered by chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1944551') to compound_records on doc_id, then to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and finally to compound_structures on molregno. Output columns must be exactly: chembl_id, pref_name, max_phase, molecule_type, canonical_smiles. Sort the results by chembl_id in ascending order. Do not apply any row limits.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON cr.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1944551' ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC
